sourceText: User asked Codex to take over story B-2fb7. Existing story title: Add validate heartbeat progress and forced-exit cleanup. Existing checklist requires a red repro for silent validate idle-kill, JSON-safe validate progress and heartbeat, forced-exit/stale-lock hardening, infra-failure classification, and story_advance TEST integration/regression coverage.
normalizedOutcome: Long-running validation that is doing real work emits visible heartbeat/progress so story_advance --phase=TEST does not die from idle silence; JSON stdout stays parseable; true command timeouts still fail closed with exact diagnostics; forced-exit failures and stale locks are classified as runner infrastructure issues.
acceptanceClaim: A bounded silent validate command that previously triggers the CLI idle watchdog is kept alive by flushed validate heartbeat without corrupting --json stdout, while an over-timeout command still fails with timeout diagnostics and infra_failure classification.
